Four new modules, and every release file is now built, tested and signed by GitHub Actions.

**New modules**
- `pii-redactor.wasm`: replaces emails, phone numbers, card numbers, SSNs, IBANs, IP addresses and names you list with consistent placeholders before text reaches an AI model or a log, with an optional map to restore them
- `csv-cleaner.wasm`: reads messy CSV exports, detecting the delimiter, header row and decimal style, skipping title and totals rows, and reporting rows it couldn't read
- `text-chunker.wasm`: splits long text into overlapping chunks along headings, paragraphs and sentences, with stable IDs, ready to embed for retrieval (RAG)
- `record-diff.wasm`: compares an incoming record with the stored version and returns only the changed fields, a patch and old/new values

**How releases are built**
- Each file is built from the tagged source on GitHub after the unit tests and a contract check (no imports; `memory`, `alloc` and `invoke` exported; the sample input returns valid JSON) pass.
- `SHA256SUMS` lists a checksum for every file.
- Each file has a signed build provenance attestation: `gh attestation verify <file> --repo neblexhq/neblex-wasm-modules`.

The ten modules from v0.1.0 are included unchanged. Modules are 60 to 175 KB.
